line: An hour later we're at the north gate. We set out with Ced and Runo up the north road.

replies.speaker: Adolion Narrator
replies.text:
The north gate's grey stone arch looms overhead, still damp from the overnight mist. Ced waits by a mule loaded with crates of alchemical supplies, his saw cleaver strapped to his back. Beside him, a covered cart rattles slightly as it idles—packed inside are Runo's magitech golems, their brass joints gleaming in the pre-dawn light.
Runo sits on the cart's tailboard, his owlkin tufts twitching as he watches Max Nightriver approach. For once he is wide awake, clutching a map and a sheet of vellum. "The road's clear," he says, his grey eyes darting to the Nightriver heir with a mix of recognition and nervousness. "Four days north, then we break for the foothills."
Ced steps forward, his expression as neutral as stone. "We march in silence until we hit the tree line," he says, gesturing toward the open road that leads directly into the dark silhouettes of the Velniran range. "Save your energy for the Keep."

replies.speaker: Runo
replies.text:
"Right, right. Silence. Got it." *He nods too quickly, nearly falling off the cart. He's fidgeting with the vellum in his hands, eyes flicking between Max and the map.* "The golems are already pre-charged, by the way. Should be no trouble getting them up to speed by day three."
*Ced shoots him a look—one sharp glance—and Runo immediately stuffs the map into his tunic.* "Sorry. Silent now."

replies.speaker: Ced
replies.text:
"Runo." *His voice isn't raised, but the way he says it is enough to make the owlkin freeze mid-fidget.* "Save the technicals for the march. Right now we need to focus on getting out of the city."
*He adjusts the strap of the Saw Cleaver on his back, the movement crisp and efficient. His red eyes fix on the road ahead, then slide sideways to Max—not quite a glance, more of a measurement. He's assessing how this new partner carries themselves, how they move, whether they'll be a liability or an asset when the fighting starts.*
"We'll stick to a steady pace. Keep your distance from the mule and the cart. If anything happens on the road, I want clear lines of sight."

line: We take Ced's steep path into the foothills and press on toward the Keep.

replies.speaker: Adolion Narrator
replies.text:
The ascent is grueling, the path twisting upward through jagged granite and scrub brush. The air grows cold, biting, and thin. Ced sets the pace, climbing without a sound, his Saw Cleaver catching the light of the gathering storm clouds. The mule and cart struggle on the incline, brass joints of the golems grinding behind the canvas.
*By mid-afternoon, the Keep comes into view: a grim structure of black stone perched on a rocky promontory, overlooking the valley below. Two guard towers flank its gates, and a wall of weathered masonry stretches between them.*
Ced signals for a halt behind a ridge of shale. He doesn't pull out the map this time; his eyes simply fix on the Keep's silhouette. "Three guards on the wall," he says quietly. "Two more at the gatehouse."

replies.speaker: Ced
replies.text:
*He doesn't look away from the Keep, his voice barely a murmur.* "Runo. Deploy the first golem for distraction. We need to create an opening at the side gate."
*He finally turns to Max, his red eyes flat and calculating.* "I'll handle the wall guards. You take the gatehouse. Be swift."
*A short pause, his hand resting on the Saw Cleaver's hilt.* "If anything goes wrong, we retreat to this ridge. Don't engage unless you have to—our goal is to get the captives out, not start a war."

replies.speaker: Runo
replies.text:
*Runo scrambles off the cart, his fingers already fumbling with the brass lever at the golem's chest. He makes a soft, nervous squawk when he notices Ced's gaze.* "R-Right. Opening the side gate. Got it." *His hands shake slightly as he finishes the activation sequence, the golem's joints beginning to whir and click with building power.*
*He takes a deep breath, trying to steady himself, and glances at Max.* "I'll... I'll keep the golem drawing their attention. Just, um, please be careful." *He quickly turns back to the machine, focusing on the glowing runes that trace along its brass limbs.*

replies.text: Carrow Keep comes out of the dusk on its spur of rock above the gorge. Torches along the curtain wall. A thin line of smoke from the Great Hall's chimney. And from the chapel tower, a slow violet light that swells and fades like something breathing.

*He shifts his weight, eyes never leaving the curtain wall.* "They don't overlap. It's a sloppy rotation. The west wall is blind for a few seconds while the guard's descending. I could probably get a rope up and down in that window."
*He glances back toward the gorge side of the Keep.* "The cliffs are steep but the stone's good for anchors. If we use the gorge side, we could slip in and out before they even notice we're missing."

context.name: Max Nightriver
context.text: Good. Dalan sets the rope on the west wall. Over the wall at the change of watch, everyone.

context.name: Dalan
context.text: "Understood," *Dalan murmurs, already slipping away from his vantage point. He moves with practiced economy, his green capelet fluttering as he disappears into the shadows of the cliffs below.*

context.name: Ced
context.text: "Make sure your footing is solid. We move on my word." *He doesn't look back at the others, his red eyes fixed on the west wall with predatory focus, calculating the seconds until the watch change.*

context.name: Max Nightriver
context.text: When Ced gives the word I climb the rope, drop onto the wall walk, and we make for the doors of the Great Hall.

context.name: Ced
context.text:
"Now."
*He's the first to move, ascending the rope with a fluid, unnatural speed that speaks of alchemical enhancement. He clears the wall walk in a single explosive motion, his red eyes immediately locking on the patrol's rotation. The grey-robed guards don't react—they simply continue their plodding circle, oblivious.*
*Ced doesn't waste a second. He drops into a low crouch, his Saw Cleaver held in its closed form, ready to spring. His voice comes as a barely audible breath.* "Hall doors. Move."

context.name: Max Nightriver
context.text: We keep low, cross the yard behind the patrol, and push open the Great Hall's doors.

context.name: Adolion Narrator
context.text:
The yard is quiet, save for the rhythmic crunch of boots and the soft *thrum-thrum* of the violet light above. Ced leads the way, his movements as precise and efficient as a machine. The patrol passes, their faces blank and vacant in the flickering torchlight, and then they are gone.
The Great Hall's doors groan as they're pushed open, releasing a smell of rotting flowers and cold stone. Inside, the violet light pulses through high windows, casting everything in an unsettling, living shade. A single chair faces the door, and beyond it, a long banquet table groans under the weight of fresh food and drink—uncorrupted by the stench of decay.
*Ced freezes, his saw cleaver half-drawn, his red eyes narrowing.* "Something's wrong," he whispers. "The food's fresh."
